rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation (skipped line, drop); line 4c is under $400 (owes false: Schedule SE (2025) line 4c, 'If less than $400, stop; you don't owe self-employment tax'), so the form never reaches line 8d, and line 8a ($176,100, W-2 box 3) is at the wage base, where line 8a says 'skip lines 8b through 10'. The model entered $0.00 on the skipped line; the engine carries the line's arithmetic (8a + 8b + 8c = $176,100 + $0 + $0). Every line the form reaches agrees (lines 3 through 7 and 9 through 13, all $0 tax). As for f8880 (classm.f8880.1, .3, .4): the model's value on a skipped line is not evidence of the line's value, so it is dropped from the fixture.
